name: zeb/world
description: aslnut, a world engine on WebGPU and WebGL2, for RWE templates. <World options elements onReady viewChange> makes one world on a canvas of its own and keeps its elements in step by id (a restyle sets props on the element already there, never a rebuild); useWorld, useElement and useWorldEvent read it from overlays inside <World>. aslnut's whole root API is exported beside it: earth, plane, imagery, terrain, layer, data, scale, theme, shape and the rest. The tile worker (tilesWorkerUrl) and lazy chunks sit next to the entry. Fully offline; data credits stay on screen.

source.package: aslnut (built from its sources; not on npm yet)
